privacy.ai_training_note: Planoly explicitly prohibits third-party AI providers from using customer AI Content to train their models: 'Planoly does not permit its third-party providers of Planoly AI to use the AI Content to train such third party's AI models.' Members must not submit personally identifiable information (names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, birth dates) for processing via Planoly AI. AI features are beta and provided as-is without warranties.
privacy.data_region: United States — Planoly states services are 'hosted in and provided from the United States'

security.name: Administrative, Technical, and Physical Safeguards
security.value: Planoly applies 'commercially reasonable and appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of personal information.' However, these safeguards 'cannot ensure or guarantee against the possibility of a security incident.'

security.name: Account Security
security.value: Users are responsible for keeping passwords confidential and must notify Planoly immediately of unauthorized access. No multi-factor authentication or other enhanced security features explicitly mentioned.

security.name: Data Transfer Security
security.value: No specific encryption standards, TLS versions, or protocols documented. Privacy policy provides no technical detail on data-in-transit security.

security.name: Third-Party Vendor Security
security.value: Planoly discloses sharing data with third-party vendors (payment processors, analytics providers, support platforms) but does not require or document vendor security certifications.

products.name: Planoly Social Planner (Starter Plan)
products.data_scope: Creator Content, account information, social media handles, engagement data, Creator profile data (limited to 1 social set, 60 uploads/month, 1 user)
products.notes: Entry-level plan for solo creators. Free 14-day trial available. $14/month (billed annually at $168).

products.name: Planoly Social Planner (Growth Plan)
products.data_scope: Creator Content, account information, social media handles, engagement data (2 social sets, unlimited uploads, 2 users)
products.notes: Most popular tier. Includes unlimited post scheduling, grid preview, DM automation, link-in-bio. $24/month (billed annually at $288).

products.name: Planoly Social Planner (Pro Plan)
products.data_scope: Creator Content, account information, social media handles, engagement data (6 social sets, unlimited uploads, 6 users, team management)
products.notes: For agencies. Full feature set including advanced analytics, team collaboration, API access. $47/month (billed annually at $444).

products.name: Planoly Creator Store
products.data_scope: Creator Content, transaction data, Customer purchase history, shipping information (via Printful integration)
products.notes: Link-in-bio storefront allowing creators to sell digital products and merchandise. Powered by Printful print-on-demand. Payment processing via third-party providers.

products.name: Planoly AI Assistant
products.data_scope: Content ideas, caption suggestions, trending audio recommendations. NO PII processing allowed.
products.notes: Beta feature. Generates content ideas and auto-magically creates captions. Explicitly prohibits training third-party AI on customer content. Cannot process personally identifiable information.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based: Starter ($14/mo), Growth ($24/mo), Pro ($47/mo). Free plan with 10 uploads/month in mobile app. Free 14-day trial on all paid plans.
compare.data_residency: United States only. Hosted in and provided from the US. No EU-specific data residency option documented.

flags: No enterprise-grade certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) despite ~8M user base and growth-stage maturity
No dedicated security or trust center documentation — only standard privacy policy and terms
Security details minimal: mentions 'commercially reasonable safeguards' but provides no encryption standards, audit scope, or technical specifications
Data residency is US-only; customers requiring GDPR compliance or EU data residency may need alternative solutions
AI features are beta, provided as-is without warranties, and lack formal governance certifications (ISO/IEC 42001, CSA STAR AI)
No public evidence of data processing agreement (DPA) for EU/GDPR compliance
Third-party vendor security requirements and audit standards not documented
Payment processing delegated to external vendors; Planoly does not hold PCI DSS itself
